item.text: {"decisions":[{"decision_id":"0d1a55aefe51fc09bf93-2","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"範例依名稱取得已載入的 libc.so 基底位址並傾印其內容，符合規則允許的原生模組檢查。","evidence":"const libc = Process . getModuleByName ( ' libc.so ' ). base ; console . log ( hexdump ( libc"},{"decision_id":"1861d4a6bf313498ccde-2","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"範例只檢查名稱已知的單一模組，未說明如何列舉已映射的函式庫或檢視其映射清單。","evidence":"const libc = Process . getModuleByName ( ' libc.so ' ). base ; console . log ( hexdump ( libc"},{"decision_id":"6678904b62c3f3d633b1-2","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"依名稱查找 libc.so 無法列出程序目前載入的原生模組。","evidence":"const libc = Process . getModuleByName ( ' libc.so ' ). base"},{"decision_id":"6ff06d20ae9ac89bbb58-2","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"片段展示如何查找使用者空間程序中的函式庫，未提供 Linux 核心模組的列舉方法。","evidence":"const libc = Process . getModuleByName ( ' libc.so ' ). base"},{"decision_id":"903cfc56ed04aec51d3f-2","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"片段說明如何隱藏記憶體範圍，僅提及列舉 API，未展示如何列出共享函式庫或顯示其映射。","evidence":"Cloak.addRange(range) : updates the registry of cloaked resources so the given memory range becomes invisible to cloak-aware APIs, such as Process.enumerateRanges() ."},{"decision_id":"ef469ffbb833a81473a9-2","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"範例示範依名稱取得程序中已載入的原生模組，並從其基底位址讀取內容。","evidence":"const libc = Process . getModuleByName ( ' libc.so ' ). base ; console . log ( hexdump ( libc"},{"decision_id":"f7461b5888c3a9604f32-2","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"範例查找單一已知匯出符號來建立控制流程圖，未列舉指定模組的匯出符號。","evidence":"const f = Module . getGlobalExportByName ( ' open ' ); const cfg = new ControlFlowGraph ( f );"}]}
